ai_language_tip: Speak warm, relaxed Australian/New Zealand-friendly English (en); understand local terms like 'arvo', 'rego', 'ute', and NZ 'kia ora'.
english_ok: often — Native English across Australia and New Zealand.
politeness: Friendly, upbeat, informal-polite ('Hi there / Good morning, calling for...', 'please', 'thanks heaps / cheers'); avoid stiff hierarchy.
name_tip: First name and surname (e.g. Jack Taylor, Aroha Williams); casual venues often use first name + initial, clinics/hotels use full name.
phone_tip: AU mobile 0491 570 156 (4-3-3), landline 02 5550 1234; NZ mobile 021 123 4567 or 027 123 4567; '0' spoken 'oh' or 'zero'; SMS confirmation standard.
time_tip: 12-hour AM/PM spoken ('7 PM', 'half past six'); 'arvo' = afternoon; avoid 'half seven' ambiguity by always saying 'seven thirty PM'.
number_tip: '0' as 'oh', repeated digits as 'double four' / 'triple zero'; watch NZ short-i vowel shift ('six' vs 'sex', 'ten' vs 'tin').
avoid_calling: Avoid cafe brunch rush 08:30–11:00, dinner rush 18:00–19:30, and evening calls after 20:00 (Aussie/Kiwi businesses close earlier than Asia/Europe).
closed_days: Retail closes early (~17:00–17:30) except Thu/Fri late-night shopping; many salons/bistros close Sun–Mon; state Public Holidays and Xmas–Jan shutdowns.
booking_channels: OpenTable, SevenRooms, Now Book It, First Table for dining; HotDoc and HealthEngine (AU) or ManageMyHealth (NZ) for GPs; Fresha/Timely for salons.
voice_menu: Medical centers, pathology/radiology, councils, Centrelink/IRD, banks, telcos (Telstra/Spark), and insurers use heavy keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Automated SMS ('Reply Y to confirm') from HotDoc, Timely, Fresha, and SevenRooms is universal 24h before appointments.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 澳紐週日與國定假日餐廳普遍加收 10%～15% 假日服務費（Surcharge），熱門餐廳常發簡訊要求留卡擔保。
usually_asked: Date and preferred sitting time (early vs late dinner sitting)
Number of people including kids/pram/highchair
Indoor vs outdoor/courtyard/beer-garden seating
Dietary needs (coeliac/GF, vegan, allergies) or BYO wine question
Full name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Weekend or Public Holiday surcharge (10–15%) applies
Sends Now Book It / SevenRooms SMS link for card pre-authorisation
Cafes often walk-in only on weekends

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card details over phone for group booking

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 醫療中心（Medical Centre）常有按鍵語音且必核對生日，並會說明是否全額健保給付（Bulk billing）或自付差額。
usually_asked: Existing or new patient at the practice
Standard (10–15 min) vs long consultation, dental check/clean, or ACC injury (NZ)
Patient full name
Preferred doctor and date/time
Mobile number for SMS confirmation

may_come_up.what: Out-of-pocket gap fee applies (mixed/private billing vs bulk billing in AU)
NZ clinic asks if visit is accident-related for ACC claim
Clinic reception preceded by keypad IVR menu

sensitive_asked.what: Asks patient date of birth, AU Medicare number, or NZ NHI number

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 許多髮廊與美甲店透過 Timely 或 Fresha 傳簡訊要求新客付訂金或留卡擔保。
usually_asked: Service details (cut, foils/balayage, SNS/BIAB nails, massage)
Hair length or existing gel removal
Preferred day, time, and stylist
Client name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Sends Timely/Fresha SMS link for booking deposit
Saturday or public holiday surcharge applies

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card details over phone for deposit
Demands immediate PayID/bank transfer on call

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與驗車（澳洲 RWC/Pink Slip、紐西蘭 WoF）必問車牌號碼（Rego），通常要求一早送車。
usually_asked: Vehicle 'rego' (registration plate), make, and model, or device model
Logbook service, roadworthy/Pink Slip (AU), WoF (NZ), or fault check
Morning drop-off time (typically 08:00–08:30) and pickup deadline
Name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Mechanic asks rego plate to check exact variant and parts
Loan car request incurs daily fee or requires advance booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone passcode for handset repair
Demands card prepayment for ordering parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 社區炸魚薯條、泰餐、披薩與烤雞店極常接電話訂自取（Pick-up）到店付款。
usually_asked: Pick-up vs local delivery and suburb/branch check
Order items, sizes, and dietary/spice options
Ready time (usually 15–25 minutes)
First name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Card payment surcharge (1–1.5%) on pickup
Delivery available only via Uber Eats / DoorDash / Menulog

sensitive_asked.what: Asks credit card details over phone
Requires immediate prepayment before cooking

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型連鎖（JB Hi-Fi、Bunnings等）有部門轉接選單，獨立商店、肉鋪與書店可電話留貨（Put aside）。
usually_asked: Product name, brand, size, or model/SKU
Quantity and physical shelf stock check
Same-day pick-up time (remember early ~17:00 shop closing!)
Name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Shop closes at 17:00/17:30; unpaid hold kept until close only

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card payment over phone to hold stock

change.before_dialing_zh: 診所、牙醫與高檔餐廳常有 24 小時內改退收取取消費的規定。
usually_asked: Full name and mobile number
Original booking date and time
New preferred time or cancellation
Updated pax/service details if changing

may_come_up.what: Cancellation fee within 24 hours of appointment/table

sensitive_asked.what: Medical clinic asks date of birth to open patient record

usually_asked: Specific question (BYO corkage, public holiday hours/surcharge, dog-friendly courtyard, stock)
Day and time of visit
Group size if asking walk-in availability
Whether caller wants to make a booking

may_come_up.what: BYO bottled wine only (no beer/spirits) with per-bottle/per-head corkage
Kitchen closes at 20:00/20:30 even if venue stays open

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 汽車旅館（Motel/Holiday Park）電話訂房很友善但常問卡號擔保，且接待櫃檯傍晚常提早下班。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates
Adults, children, and room/cabin type
Estimated arrival time (regional motels close reception ~18:00–20:00)
Guest full name, mobile, and email

may_come_up.what: Late check-in after reception closes requires lockbox arrangement
Offers sending email payment link to secure room

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone to guarantee room

activity.before_dialing_zh: 高爾夫球敘、草地滾球（Barefoot bowls）、保齡球與包場可電話問，散客體驗課多走網站預付。
usually_asked: Activity type (tee time, barefoot bowls, lanes, court hire)
Date, start time, and duration
Group size and equipment/cart hire
Contact name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Directs small bookings to online portal
Group booking requires deposit invoice by email

sensitive_asked.what: Requests phone card payment to lock slot

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供完整街道地址與 Suburb；技師（Tradie）工作時常漏接電話，留語音或傳簡訊後通常會回電。
usually_asked: Job type (plumber, sparky/electrician, split-system aircon clean, pest, locksmith)
Street address, suburb, and single vs double-storey house/apartment
Preferred day and morning/arvo window
Parking/driveway access and dogs on property
Name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Call-out fee plus hourly rate (incl./excl. GST) quoted
Tradie on tools asks owner to text photos of job

sensitive_asked.what: Asks lockbox PIN or gate code
Demands PayID/bank transfer before visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、美容與寄宿皆採預約制，夏天與聖誕長假寄宿需提早數月預訂並查 C5（狗）/ F3（貓）疫苗。
usually_asked: Vet consult, clip/wash groom, or boarding
Breed, weight, age, and desexed status
Current C5 (dog) or F3 (cat) vaccination and tick prevention
Preferred date and drop-off time
Owner full name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Peak Christmas/school-holiday boarding requires deposit invoice
Matted coat clip-off fee applies

sensitive_asked.what: Requests immediate phone card payment for holiday boarding

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Australia Post、NZ Post、StarTrack 等全國物流皆為語音機器人或按鍵選單，僅地方獨立店家與車行可直撥查單。
usually_asked: Order, invoice, or job card number
Customer surname and mobile number
Suburb or item description
Collection readiness or status

may_come_up.what: Courier hotline uses automated voice/keypad triage

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth or security PIN

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、電信、能源電力、保險與航空客服皆有按鍵 IVR 且受隱私法限制須本人核對生日與安全碼，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: Keypad or voice IVR routing
Account holder presence check under Privacy Act
Full name, date of birth, and residential address/PIN
Account, policy, or booking number

may_come_up.what: Refuses assistant without listed Authorised Representative on account

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth, phone PIN, Medicare/driver licence, card, or OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 計程車隊（13cabs、Blue Bubble）、機場接駁車（Airport Shuttle）與地方租車行皆可電話預約。
usually_asked: Street address, suburb, and pickup time
Destination or airport terminal
Passengers, luggage, baby capsule/child seat, or Maxi Taxi need
Passenger name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Shared airport shuttle gives 15–20 min pickup window
13cabs automated IVR may answer before human operator

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card prepayment over phone for shuttle/hire car
Asks driver licence number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: 澳紐租屋多為固定開放看房時段（Open for Inspection），電話主要用來問私人看房或確認場次，多要求上網登記。
usually_asked: Property street address and suburb (Domain/Realestate.com.au/Trade Me)
Whether published Saturday/midweek Open Home suits or private inspection needed
Move-in date, lease term, and household/pet profile
Full name, mobile, and email to register for inspection updates

may_come_up.what: Agent directs prospective tenant to register via online link (Snug/Ignite/InspectRealEstate)

sensitive_asked.what: Requests holding deposit before inspection

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府機關（Centrelink、Service NSW、IRD）與市議會多有按鍵選單；托兒中心（Childcare/Kindy）約參觀與排隊名額很常接電話。
usually_asked: General council/school inquiry or childcare tour request
Child age group (nursery/toddler/kindy) and exact days of week needed
Preferred start month and tour time
Parent name, phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Childcare has waitlist on popular days (Tue–Thu) vs Fri availability
Council/agency switchboard uses keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CRN (Centrelink Reference Number), IRD number, or child DOB
